newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse ends lower on banks' drift down.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse ends lower on banks' drift down.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed slightly lower for the second consecutive day on Tuesday, pulled down by large capitalisation companies, brokers said.
The all-share index closed at 436.53 points, down 0.11 percent compared with the previous session.
"The market movement is not linked to any major change, but to fluctuation of market shares," one stockbroker said.
Banque Commerciale du Maroc, the market largest capitalisation, lost three dirhams to close at 687 dirhams.
Wafabank, one the market's liquid stocks, lost six dirhams to close at 540 dirhams.

ONA Group, Morocco's largest private group, lost three dirhams to close at 492 dirhams. Steel mill SONASID , which was recently partly privatised, closed at 326, down four dirhams over the previous session. Traded volume on the official market was 23.3 million dirhams compared with 19.9 million on Monday.
